import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import os
from sklearn.model_selection import StratifiedKFold
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
import xgboost as xgb

# Load data
train_df = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")
sample_sub = pd.read_csv("./input/sample_submission.csv")

# Prepare features
ids = test_df["id"].values
cols_to_use = [c for c in train_df.columns if c not in ["id", "target"]]
X_train = train_df[cols_to_use].copy()
y_train = train_df["target"].astype(int).values
X_test = test_df[cols_to_use].copy()

# Handle categorical f_27
encoder = xgb.XGBEncoder(objective="binary")
encoder.fit(X_train)
X_train_enc = encoder.transform(X_train)
X_test_enc = encoder.transform(X_test)

# Convert to arrays for XGBoost DMatrix
from scipy.sparse import csr_matrix

X_train_arr = csr_matrix(X_train_enc)
X_test_arr = csr_matrix(X_test_enc)

# Set parameters
params = {
    "objective": "binary:logistic",
    "eval_metric": "auc",
    "max_depth": 6,
    "eta": 0.1,
    "subsample": 0.8,
    "colsample_bytree": 0.8,
    "min_child_weight": 3,
    "gamma": 0,
    "reg_alpha": 0.1,
    "reg_lambda": 1,
    "random_state": 42,
    "tree_method": "hist",
    "nthread": 16,
}

# Cross-validation loop with proper holdout tracking
cv_aucs = []
all_cv_preds = []
all_cv_labels = []

n_splits = 5
skf = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=n_splits, shuffle=True, random_state=42)

for fold, (train_idx, val_idx) in enumerate(skf.split(X_train_arr, y_train)):
    X_tr_fold = X_train_arr[train_idx]
    y_tr_fold = y_train[train_idx]
    X_val_fold = X_train_arr[val_idx]
    y_val_fold = y_train[val_idx]

    # Create DMatrices
    dtr = xgb.DMatrix(X_tr_fold, label=y_tr_fold)
    dval = xgb.DMatrix(X_val_fold, label=y_val_fold)

    # Train with early stopping
    watch_list = [(dtr, "train"), (dval, "val")]
    model = xgb.train(
        params,
        dtr,
        num_boost_round=1000,
        evals=watch_list,
        early_stopping_rounds=50,
        verbose_eval=False,
    )

    # Predict on validation
    val_preds = model.predict(dval)

    # Compute AUC on THIS fold's held-out validation set only
    fold_auc = roc_auc_score(y_val_fold, val_preds)
    cv_aucs.append(fold_auc)

    all_cv_preds.extend(val_preds)
    all_cv_labels.extend(y_val_fold)

    print(f"Fold {fold+1} AUC: {fold_auc:.6f}")

# Calculate mean CV score from proper fold AUCs
mean_cv_auc = np.mean(cv_aucs)
print(f"{mean_cv_auc:.6f}")

# Train final model on ALL training data
final_dtrain = xgb.DMatrix(X_train_arr, label=y_train)
final_model = xgb.train(params, final_dtrain, num_boost_round=1000)

# Generate final prediction on test set
final_dtest = xgb.DMatrix(X_test_arr)
final_preds = final_model.predict(final_dtest)

# Save submission to correct location
submission_df = pd.DataFrame({"id": ids, "target": final_preds})
os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)
submission_df.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
print("Submission saved to ./submission/submission.csv")
